notes:
### Added
- **PKMNDB English catalogue sync.** `npm run sync-pkmndb` pulls the latest
  `dist/sets.json` + `dist/cards.jsonl` from `ImLogueybear/PKMNDB`, refreshes
  English card metadata/artwork and adds missing sets (World Championship decks,
  Play! Prize Packs, Battle Academy, trainer kits, 30th Celebration subsets and
  more). Existing app set/card ids, names and holo/1st-edition flags are kept.
- **Hosted R2 artwork.** English cards now use PKMNDB's
  `pub-54a2*.r2.dev/cards/...` images, with TCGdex/pokemontcg.io retained as
  fallbacks. URLs are versioned with the image hash (`?v=...`) so stale cached
  copies are not reused. TCG Pocket and Japanese rows are unchanged.
- Optional `imageThumb` on cards, so grids can use a provider's small image when
  one is available.
- `npm run audit-cards` writes `MISSING_CARDS.md` + `MISSING_CARDS.csv` with
  PKMNDB English gaps, Japanese set/card deltas and missing artwork.
- **Japanese PKMNDB catalogue merge.** `npm run sync-pkmndb-ja` merges all 450
  populated PKMNDB Japanese sets (including promos, starter/deck-build sets and
  alternate printings) into `src/data/cards.ja.json` + `src/data/jpSets.ts`.
  Existing ids, names and TCG Collector artwork are preserved; missing
  printings in matched sets are added by printed number, and new sets get
  `ja-pkmndb-<set id>` ids plus English labels in `src/data/jpNames.ts`.
- **English artwork gap fill.** `npm run fill-artwork` reads
  `MISSING_CARDS.csv` and fills the TCG Pocket promos/new sets from TCGdex and
  Limitless TCG Pocket, and My First Battle from PKMNDB deck images (also
  correcting the previous repeated-number mappings).

### Changed
- **Renamed the project/repo/app to PocketVaultTCG.** The GitHub repo is now
  `ImLogueybear/PocketVaultTCG`, the Android display name is PocketVaultTCG, and
  the application id is `com.imlogueybear.pocketvaulttcg` (previously
  `com.tcgchecker.app`). Existing installs use the old package identity and are
  a separate app, so export the collection JSON and restore it after installing.
- `src/data/cards.json` and `src/data/wotcSets.ts` are now generated from
  PKMNDB (27,851 cards / 349 English sets, up from 23,735 / 216).
- Japanese coverage is now 450 sets / 28,513 cards (up from 118 / 13,006);
  `jpNames.ts` gains curated English labels for the new PKMNDB sets.
- Gallery and vault subsets (Shiny Vault, Trainer Gallery, Crown Zenith Galarian
  Gallery, 30th Classic Collection) are split into their existing app sets
  instead of duplicating cards in the parent set.
- The PWA precache limit and card-data chunk warning now accommodate the larger
  two-catalogue snapshot; TCGdex, R2 and Limitless artwork are runtime-cached.

### Notes
- Scan-index rebuild still required: both catalogues and reference image URLs
  changed. Run `npm run scan-index` (full rebuild) so the new sets/cards are
  scannable; the published index predates this merge.
- `DATA_VERSION` uses a content hash (`all-pkmndb-<snapshot>-<hash>`) and is
  updated automatically by the sync script whenever the catalogue changes.
- `npm run audit-cards` now reports zero missing English cards, zero missing
  Japanese sets/cards and zero cards without artwork.
